blocks.text: LOS ANGELES–Former champion Elina Svitolina powered past Wimbledon winner Linda Noskova 6-2 6-1 on Saturday to book a WTA Finals title clash with Mirra Andreeva at Indian Wells, California. Ukrainian veteran Svitolina won the WTA Finals in 2018, fell to Ashleigh Barty in the final the following year, but hadn’t been back since.
